about: H3f mutants of hosts/mygo and its drawing module. scripts/mutants measures the Ergo module only; each edit here is applied to a scratch copy of the repository without .git (the layout tests build bin/ergo from it; an H2L mutant edits std ui/layout, which only hosts/mygo's oracle holds to MyGo), then drawgen runs in drawing/ unless regenerate is false (as go generate would after the edit), then the killers run. A killer is module:Test, where module is drawing or mygo.

mutants.name: H3f-consts-dropped
mutants.rule: every exported constant of a drawing-layer package is mirrored

mutants.name: H3f-args-reordered
mutants.rule: a wrapper calls the internal function with its parameters in order

mutants.name: H3f-layer-dropped
mutants.rule: the export reaches every layer a host draws with

mutants.name: H3f-hand-edit
mutants.rule: the drawing packages are what drawgen writes from the pinned MyGo

mutants.name: H2L-gap-after-last
mutants.rule: a gap goes between children, not after the last

mutants.name: H2L-grow-by-count
mutants.rule: free space is shared by grow weight, not by count

mutants.name: H2L-cross-padding-ignored
mutants.rule: a row places its children inside its padding across the line

mutants.name: H2L-dirty-not-propagated
mutants.rule: a change forgets what the nodes up to the root computed

mutants.name: H2L-no-reuse
mutants.rule: a box laid out at its size with nothing changed in it is kept, not computed again
